# Islam & Associates International

> Islam & Associates International is an elite law firm headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh, offering comprehensive legal counsel and advocacy across Corporate, Civil, Criminal, Immigration, and Family Law since 1997.

## Key Information
- **Full Legal Name**: Islam & Associates International
- **Common Names**: Islam & Associates, Islam and Associates International Law Offices
- **Headquarters**: 1st Floor, 30 Court House Street, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
- **Founded**: 1997
- **Jurisdiction**: Supreme Court of Bangladesh, High Court Division, District Courts, International cross-border jurisdictions
- **Languages**: English, Bengali (বাংলা)
- **Official Website**: https://islamandassociates.com

## Primary Practice Areas
- **Corporate & Commercial Law**: Company formation, FDI, mergers & acquisitions, regulatory compliance, contract drafting.
- **Civil Litigation**: Land & property disputes, contract enforcement, recovery, injunctions, appellate practice.
- **Criminal Defense**: White-collar crimes, financial fraud, bail hearings, anti-corruption, trial & appeals.
- **Immigration Law**: Cross-border immigration, work permits, visa appeals, citizenship, international relocations.
- **Family & Matrimonial Law**: Divorce, child custody, inheritance, Muslim & civil marriage laws, property succession.
- **Banking, Finance & Tax**: Debt recovery, loan syndication, tax disputes, VAT, securities regulation.
- **Intellectual Property**: Trademark registration, copyright, patent filing, IP infringement defense.

## Leadership & International Accreditations
- Led by internationally trained Senior Advocates and Barristers with certifications and training from Harvard University (Internet Law), Central Law Training (England), Kensington University (USA), and legal associations in London and New York.
- Established record of 500+ successful cases and 27+ years of continuous legal excellence.

## Official Online Services
- **Online Consultation Booking**: Direct scheduling with specialized advocates.
- **Live Case Tracker**: Real-time status, hearing dates, and lawyer notes for active clients.
- **Legal Insights & Articles**: Deep analysis on current Bangladeshi statutes, Supreme Court precedents, and foreign investment regulations.
